title: Dr. Ambedkar & The Making of the Indian Constitution
subtitle: From Chief Architect to the Union of Trinity: Drafting Modern India's Magna Carta
summary: Explore the intellectual crucible through which Dr. B.R. Ambedkar engineered the democratic bedrock of the Republic of India, harmonizing fundamental rights, social justice, and constitutional morality.

title: The Mahad Satyagraha: Awakening Civil Rights
subtitle: Water as Equality: The 1927 March at Chhadar Tank
summary: The dramatic story of Dr. Ambedkar's 1927 Mahad campaign, widely heralded as India's declaration of human equality and the genesis of modern civil rights assertion.

title: Monetary Economics & The Genesis of the Reserve Bank
subtitle: Dr. Ambedkar's Economic Treatises and Colonial Currency Reform
summary: An extraordinary journey through Dr. Ambedkar's doctoral research at the London School of Economics, culminating in his testimony before the Royal Commission that gave birth to the Reserve Bank of India.
